groups.instruction: In each question three words are shown, and a code word is made from the FIRST and THIRD of them — never the middle one. The rule is stated, and one worked example is given. Apply the same rule to the second set of three words to make its code word.
groups.example: Rule: the first 2 letters of word1, followed by the first 2 letters of word3. FLIGHT, PILOT, OWNER -> (FLOW). So TRIP, JOURNEY, APOLOGY -> (TRAP). The middle word is never used — it is there because the paper prints three.

questions.stem:
Rule: the first 3 letters of word1, followed by the last 1 letter of word3.
FARMER, FIELD, TEAM -> (FARM)
BARREL, CASK, INK -> ( ? )
questions.explanation: Taking the first 3 letters of word1, followed by the last 1 letter of word3 from BARREL and INK gives BARK.
